agent_authentication_bindings_unbound_re.name: agent_authentication_bindings_unbound_reason_paired
agent_authentication_bindings_unbound_re.value: ("agent_authentication_bindings"."unbound_at_ms" is null and "agent_authentication_bindings"."unbound_reason" is null) or ("agent_authentication_bindings"."unbound_at_ms" is not null and "agent_authentication_bindings"."unbound_reason" is not null)

agent_releases_image_digest_valid.name: agent_releases_image_digest_valid
agent_releases_image_digest_valid.value: length("agent_releases"."image_digest") = 71 and substr("agent_releases"."image_digest", 1, 7) = 'sha256:' and substr("agent_releases"."image_digest", 8) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

authentication_accounts_connected_creden.name: authentication_accounts_connected_credential_valid
authentication_accounts_connected_creden.value: "authentication_accounts"."connection_state" <> 'connected' or "authentication_accounts"."custody_kind" in ('managed_exchange', 'none') or "authentication_accounts"."credential_ref" is not null

connector_installations_profile_revision.name: connector_installations_profile_revision_paired
connector_installations_profile_revision.value: ("connector_installations"."profile_connector_id" is null and "connector_installations"."applied_profile_revision" is null) or ("connector_installations"."profile_connector_id" is not null and "connector_installations"."applied_profile_revision" > 0)

connector_release_mappings_output_hash_v.name: connector_release_mappings_output_hash_valid
connector_release_mappings_output_hash_v.value: "connector_release_capability_mappings"."output_schema_sha256" is null or (length("connector_release_capability_mappings"."output_schema_sha256") = 64 and "connector_release_capability_mappings"."output_schema_sha256" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

connector_releases_revocation_paired.name: connector_releases_revocation_paired
connector_releases_revocation_paired.value: ("connector_releases"."revoked_at_ms" is null and "connector_releases"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("connector_releases"."revoked_at_ms" is not null and length(trim("connector_releases"."revocation_reason")) > 0)

tool_bindings_output_hash_valid.name: tool_bindings_output_hash_valid
tool_bindings_output_hash_valid.value: "tool_bindings"."output_schema_sha256" is null or (length("tool_bindings"."output_schema_sha256") = 64 and "tool_bindings"."output_schema_sha256" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

tool_providers_profile_revision_paired.name: tool_providers_profile_revision_paired
tool_providers_profile_revision_paired.value: ("tool_providers"."profile_connection_id" is null and "tool_providers"."applied_profile_revision" is null) or ("tool_providers"."profile_connection_id" is not null and "tool_providers"."applied_profile_revision" > 0)

tool_providers_connector_origin_paired.name: tool_providers_connector_origin_paired
tool_providers_connector_origin_paired.value: ("tool_providers"."installation_id" is null and "tool_providers"."endpoint_id" is null) or ("tool_providers"."installation_id" is not null and "tool_providers"."endpoint_id" is not null)

tool_providers_credential_connected.name: tool_providers_credential_connected
tool_providers_credential_connected.value: "tool_providers"."connection_state" <> 'connected' or "tool_providers"."credential_ref" is not null or "tool_providers"."connected_at_ms" is not null

scheduled_runs_lease_matches_state.name: scheduled_runs_lease_matches_state
scheduled_runs_lease_matches_state.value:
(
        ("scheduled_runs"."state" = 'leased' and "scheduled_runs"."lease_token" is not null and "scheduled_runs"."lease_expires_at_ms" is not null)
        or
        ("scheduled_runs"."state" != 'leased' and "scheduled_runs"."lease_token" is null and "scheduled_runs"."lease_expires_at_ms" is null)
      )

scheduled_runs_finished_matches_state.name: scheduled_runs_finished_matches_state
scheduled_runs_finished_matches_state.value:
(
        ("scheduled_runs"."state" in ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'skipped') and "scheduled_runs"."finished_at_ms" is not null)
        or
        ("scheduled_runs"."state" not in ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'skipped') and "scheduled_runs"."finished_at_ms" is null)
      )

local_changes_target_matches_kind.name: local_changes_target_matches_kind
local_changes_target_matches_kind.value:
(
        ("local_changes"."kind" in ('project.upsert', 'project.delete') and "local_changes"."project_id" is not null and "local_changes"."project_revision" is not null and "local_changes"."session_id" is null and "local_changes"."session_revision" is null and "local_changes"."event_id" is null)
        or
        ("local_changes"."kind" in ('session.upsert', 'session.event.append', 'session.delete') and "local_changes"."project_id" is null and "local_changes"."project_revision" is null and "local_changes"."session_id" is not null and "local_changes"."session_revision" is not null)
      )

agent_run_presentations_state_matches_mo.name: agent_run_presentations_state_matches_mode
agent_run_presentations_state_matches_mo.value:
(
        ("agent_run_presentations"."mode" = 'inline' and "agent_run_presentations"."initial_state" is null)
        or
        ("agent_run_presentations"."mode" = 'collapsible' and "agent_run_presentations"."initial_state" in ('expanded', 'collapsed'))
      )

composer_drafts_context_valid.name: composer_drafts_context_valid
composer_drafts_context_valid.value: ("composer_drafts"."kind" = 'new_chat' and "composer_drafts"."session_id" is null) or ("composer_drafts"."kind" = 'session' and "composer_drafts"."project_id" is null and "composer_drafts"."session_id" is not null)

file_artifacts_location_matches_availabi.name: file_artifacts_location_matches_availability
file_artifacts_location_matches_availabi.value:
(
        ("file_artifacts"."availability" = 'local' and "file_artifacts"."local_relative_path" is not null)
        or
        ("file_artifacts"."availability" in ('remote_only', 'missing') and "file_artifacts"."local_relative_path" is null)
      )

file_changes_versions_match_operation.name: file_changes_versions_match_operation
file_changes_versions_match_operation.value:
(
        ("file_changes"."operation" = 'create' and "file_changes"."before_version_id" is null and "file_changes"."after_version_id" is not null)
        or
        ("file_changes"."operation" in ('modify', 'relocate') and "file_changes"."before_version_id" is not null and "file_changes"."after_version_id" is not null)
        or
        ("file_changes"."operation" = 'delete' and "file_changes"."before_version_id" is not null and "file_changes"."after_version_id" is null)
      )

file_changes_text_diff_paired.name: file_changes_text_diff_paired
file_changes_text_diff_paired.value:
(
        ("file_changes"."text_additions" is null and "file_changes"."text_deletions" is null)
        or
        ("file_changes"."text_additions" >= 0 and "file_changes"."text_deletions" >= 0)
      )

message_parts_value_matches_type.name: message_parts_value_matches_type
message_parts_value_matches_type.value:
(
        ("message_parts"."part_type" = 'text' and "message_parts"."text_content" is not null and "message_parts"."artifact_id" is null)
        or
        ("message_parts"."part_type" = 'artifact_reference' and "message_parts"."text_content" is null and "message_parts"."artifact_id" is not null)
      )

project_file_versions_location_matches_a.name: project_file_versions_location_matches_availability
project_file_versions_location_matches_a.value:
(
        ("project_file_versions"."availability" = 'local' and "project_file_versions"."local_relative_path" is not null)
        or
        ("project_file_versions"."availability" = 'missing' and "project_file_versions"."local_relative_path" is null)
      )
